subactions.description: England and Wales bank holidays used by the complaints flows to find working days. Refresh once a year from GOV.UK (Open Government Licence v3.0).

subactions.schemaXml: <Field ID="{ecb01c83-da3e-5f5d-9b60-ba9745433f9f}" Type="DateTime" Name="HolidayDate" StaticName="HolidayDate" DisplayName="HolidayDate" Description="Bank holiday date (England and Wales), copied from https://www.gov.uk/bank-holidays.json once a year. Put the holiday name in Title." Required="TRUE" Format="DateOnly" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="TRUE" />

subactions.description: Formal complaints register for the pilot: one row per complaint. Due dates are calendar days from the initiation date (5, 10, 30, 56, then updates at least every 28 days). Title holds the complaint reference.

subactions.schemaXml: <Field ID="{18b3c56e-4e02-5e6b-ad41-d955554d005f}" Type="Text" Name="CustomerName" StaticName="CustomerName" DisplayName="CustomerName" Description="Customer name as it appears in the email or letter." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{bd5b3ef2-b651-5b2e-af62-0ea973b409ab}" Type="Text" Name="CustomerEmail" StaticName="CustomerEmail" DisplayName="CustomerEmail" Description="Address the acknowledgement and later letters go to." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{53dcdf37-23f5-5877-959d-ae33fccb7c36}" Type="Text" Name="Development" StaticName="Development" DisplayName="Development" Description="Development name." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255" />
<Field ID="{6a382b91-885a-5927-ade4-f88bfac47eaa}" Type="Text" Name="Plot" StaticName="Plot" DisplayName="Plot" Description="Plot number, if given." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{c7a18d74-7d20-5ac8-b366-1ce0b4e7139b}" Type="DateTime" Name="ReceivedDate" StaticName="ReceivedDate" DisplayName="ReceivedDate" Description="Date and time the complaint arrived (stored in UTC by SharePoint, shown in the site time zone)." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{e1a5da62-2943-563e-9064-c471f4ad8982}" Type="DateTime" Name="InitiationDate" StaticName="InitiationDate" DisplayName="InitiationDate" Description="Complaint initiation date: the first working day after the complaint was received. Set by the intake flow; check it if entered by hand." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{862c8c8e-ace6-5c11-a552-fa561341b7a0}" Type="DateTime" Name="ReservationDate" StaticName="ReservationDate" DisplayName="ReservationDate" Description="Date of reservation, if known. Decides which code applies." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{98fbaa5d-30a9-5149-af21-e228b150de26}" Type="DateTime" Name="CompletionDate" StaticName="CompletionDate" DisplayName="CompletionDate" Description="Date of legal completion, if known." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{b206ddd5-320d-569d-bad3-7cc7fee858c6}" Type="Choice" Name="CodeVersion" StaticName="CodeVersion" DisplayName="CodeVersion" Description="Which code applies, by reservation date. The Complaints Team confirms it." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>To confirm</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Consumer Code for Home Builders</CHOICE><CHOICE>New Homes Quality Code, version 1</CHOICE><CHOICE>New Homes Quality Code, version 2</CHOICE><CHOICE>To confirm</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{a475a109-0f4c-5336-be0b-ec5cd67a0e7c}" Type="DateTime" Name="WindowEnd" StaticName="WindowEnd" DisplayName="WindowEnd" Description="Last day a formal complaint can be raised: two years from the later of reservation and completion." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{6ee32812-fd1c-5e0c-8090-af4aeb176657}" Type="Note" Name="IssuesRaised" StaticName="IssuesRaised" DisplayName="IssuesRaised" Description="The issues raised, in short, in the customer's terms." Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6" />

<Field ID="{71ce89ab-b7b1-5b4c-8eaa-494ced97bfd9}" Type="Choice" Name="Stage" StaticName="Stage" DisplayName="Stage" Description="Where the complaint is in the published process." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>Logged</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Logged</CHOICE><CHOICE>Acknowledged</CHOICE><CHOICE>Pathway sent</CHOICE><CHOICE>Full assessment sent</CHOICE><CHOICE>Next steps sent</CHOICE><CHOICE>Concluded</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{ef06677a-2a61-52a5-ab16-809c59a2de6e}" Type="Calculated" Name="AckDue" StaticName="AckDue" DisplayName="AckDue" Description="Acknowledgement due: initiation date plus 5 calendar days." Required="FALSE" ResultType="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" ReadOnly="TRUE"><Formula>=IF(ISBLANK([InitiationDate]),"",[InitiationDate]+5)</Formula><FieldRefs><FieldRef Name="InitiationDate" /></FieldRefs></Field>

<Field ID="{33cef8ea-7774-5d36-8120-7b7bd88754c1}" Type="DateTime" Name="AckSent" StaticName="AckSent" DisplayName="AckSent" Description="When the acknowledgement was sent. Written by the letter approval flow." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{5aa18679-16b3-5406-a58e-016f95b2a10d}" Type="Calculated" Name="PathwayDue" StaticName="PathwayDue" DisplayName="PathwayDue" Description="Proposed pathway due: initiation date plus 10 calendar days." Required="FALSE" ResultType="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" ReadOnly="TRUE"><Formula>=IF(ISBLANK([InitiationDate]),"",[InitiationDate]+10)</Formula><FieldRefs><FieldRef Name="InitiationDate" /></FieldRefs></Field>

<Field ID="{0bb03228-7fae-524e-8845-a6deb6bad25b}" Type="DateTime" Name="PathwaySent" StaticName="PathwaySent" DisplayName="PathwaySent" Description="When the proposed pathway to resolution was sent." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{fdfef2f1-3e56-5476-ad47-540d375fadd4}" Type="Calculated" Name="AssessmentDue" StaticName="AssessmentDue" DisplayName="AssessmentDue" Description="Full assessment due: initiation date plus 30 calendar days." Required="FALSE" ResultType="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" ReadOnly="TRUE"><Formula>=IF(ISBLANK([InitiationDate]),"",[InitiationDate]+30)</Formula><FieldRefs><FieldRef Name="InitiationDate" /></FieldRefs></Field>

<Field ID="{023d5357-0d89-512d-b22f-ce584a7825a9}" Type="DateTime" Name="AssessmentSent" StaticName="AssessmentSent" DisplayName="AssessmentSent" Description="When the full assessment was sent." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{efd0ed2f-20f4-52fe-bd52-f184f17ce414}" Type="Calculated" Name="NextStepsDue" StaticName="NextStepsDue" DisplayName="NextStepsDue" Description="If unresolved, next steps and timescales due: initiation date plus 56 calendar days." Required="FALSE" ResultType="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" ReadOnly="TRUE"><Formula>=IF(ISBLANK([InitiationDate]),"",[InitiationDate]+56)</Formula><FieldRefs><FieldRef Name="InitiationDate" /></FieldRefs></Field>

<Field ID="{fe8f8b3d-ed33-5602-9653-f8233e30a373}" Type="DateTime" Name="NextStepsSent" StaticName="NextStepsSent" DisplayName="NextStepsSent" Description="When the next steps letter was sent." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{de7af875-cb22-57b3-b717-f8be21cccecc}" Type="DateTime" Name="LastUpdateSent" StaticName="LastUpdateSent" DisplayName="LastUpdateSent" Description="When the most recent 28-day update was sent." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{28fb8974-c46e-5ea0-adba-0ddd6acdb7cc}" Type="DateTime" Name="NextUpdateDue" StaticName="NextUpdateDue" DisplayName="NextUpdateDue" Description="Next update due: 28 days after the next steps letter or the last update (or after day 56 if not yet sent). Set by the daily clock flow." Required="FALSE" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{461ba094-0411-511f-a6bc-f2c152bac083}" Type="DateTime" Name="ConcludedOn" StaticName="ConcludedOn" DisplayName="ConcludedOn" Description="When the concluding letter was sent." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{ff716a72-5122-56f2-bd83-daf81011ed32}" Type="User" Name="Owner" StaticName="Owner" DisplayName="Owner" Description="Person in the Complaints Team who owns this complaint." Required="FALSE" UserSelectionMode="0" Mult="FALSE" />

<Field ID="{3feb5ca7-a9f4-5fc3-bba9-6b84518b034e}" Type="Choice" Name="SuggestedType" StaticName="SuggestedType" DisplayName="SuggestedType" Description="Type confirmed by a person at intake. Anything that might be a complaint is logged." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><Default>Formal complaint</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Formal complaint</CHOICE><CHOICE>Aftercare item for the portal</CHOICE><CHOICE>General enquiry</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{c055bb2d-9dc4-557a-a879-47b4684eb744}" Type="User" Name="ConfirmedBy" StaticName="ConfirmedBy" DisplayName="ConfirmedBy" Description="Person who confirmed the type on the Teams card." Required="FALSE" UserSelectionMode="0" Mult="FALSE" />

<Field ID="{82b9bb0a-694b-55e9-80d0-c53716f8221f}" Type="DateTime" Name="ConfirmedOn" StaticName="ConfirmedOn" DisplayName="ConfirmedOn" Description="When the type was confirmed." Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{6610d19d-3337-5ef2-84ef-b84019638aac}" Type="Note" Name="ActivityLog" StaticName="ActivityLog" DisplayName="ActivityLog" Description="Append-only log of what happened and who did it. Needs versioning on the list." Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6" AppendOnly="TRUE" />

<Field ID="{27580dcd-a510-5dac-9bb1-f63369d6c188}" Type="Choice" Name="LetterToSend" StaticName="LetterToSend" DisplayName="LetterToSend" Description="The letter to send next. Set with LetterStatus to start the approval flow." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Acknowledgement</CHOICE><CHOICE>Proposed pathway</CHOICE><CHOICE>Full assessment</CHOICE><CHOICE>Next steps</CHOICE><CHOICE>Update</CHOICE><CHOICE>Concluding letter</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{bb47c3c5-8b09-5134-937e-4748747709d7}" Type="Note" Name="LetterDraft" StaticName="LetterDraft" DisplayName="LetterDraft" Description="Letter text for approval. Leave [ACK_DUE], [PATHWAY_DUE] or [ASSESSMENT_DUE] in place if you wish: the approval flow fills them from this register." Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6" />

<Field ID="{1e96b59b-141d-5e18-846a-b07d03538270}" Type="Choice" Name="LetterStatus" StaticName="LetterStatus" DisplayName="LetterStatus" Description="Set to "Ready for approval" to send LetterDraft for approval." Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Ready for approval</CHOICE><CHOICE>Awaiting approval</CHOICE><CHOICE>Sent</CHOICE><CHOICE>Returned for changes</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{6cd504b2-ffbe-50b6-82c5-a82b06c109cd}" Type="Text" Name="SourceEmailId" StaticName="SourceEmailId" DisplayName="SourceEmailId" Description="Internet message ID of the original email. It stays the same if the email is moved, so the intake flow uses it to avoid logging the same email twice." Required="FALSE" MaxLength="255" />

attributes.title: Acknowledgement: due 5 calendar days after the initiation date. "Due soon" means within 2 calendar days of the due date; the daily reminder flow uses working days and bank holidays.

style.color: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#3B3A39', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0 && [$AckSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), '#0B5A0B', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0, '#7A3105', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#3B3A39', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), '#8E1F25', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 3), '#5C4300', '#004578'))))))
style.background-color: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#F3F2F1', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0 && [$AckSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), '#DFF6DD', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0, '#FDE7D9', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#F3F2F1', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), '#FDE7E9', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 3), '#FFF4CE', '#EFF6FC'))))))

=if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#605E5C', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0 && [$AckSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), '#107C10', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0, '#B84500', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#605E5C', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), '#A4262C', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 3), '#8A6400', '#0067B8'))))))

children.txtContent: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, 'No start date', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0 && [$AckSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), 'Sent', if(length([$AckSent]) > 0, 'Sent late', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', 'Not needed', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 6), 'Overdue', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 3), 'Due soon', 'On track'))))))

attributes.title: Proposed pathway to resolution: due 10 calendar days after the initiation date. "Due soon" means within 2 calendar days of the due date; the daily reminder flow uses working days and bank holidays.

style.color: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#3B3A39', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0 && [$PathwaySent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), '#0B5A0B', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0, '#7A3105', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#3B3A39', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), '#8E1F25', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 8), '#5C4300', '#004578'))))))
style.background-color: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#F3F2F1', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0 && [$PathwaySent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), '#DFF6DD', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0, '#FDE7D9', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#F3F2F1', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), '#FDE7E9', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 8), '#FFF4CE', '#EFF6FC'))))))

=if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#605E5C', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0 && [$PathwaySent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), '#107C10', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0, '#B84500', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#605E5C', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), '#A4262C', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 8), '#8A6400', '#0067B8'))))))

children.txtContent: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, 'No start date', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0 && [$PathwaySent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), 'Sent', if(length([$PathwaySent]) > 0, 'Sent late', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', 'Not needed', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 11), 'Overdue', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 8), 'Due soon', 'On track'))))))

subactions.name: Due this week
subactions.query: <OrderBy><FieldRef Name="AckDue" /></OrderBy><Where><And><Neq><FieldRef Name="Stage" /><Value Type="Choice">Concluded</Value></Neq><Or><Or><Or><Or><And><IsNull><FieldRef Name="AckSent" /></IsNull><Leq><FieldRef Name="AckDue" /><Value Type="DateTime"><Today OffsetDays="7" /></Value></Leq></And><And><IsNull><FieldRef Name="PathwaySent" /></IsNull><Leq><FieldRef Name="PathwayDue" /><Value Type="DateTime"><Today OffsetDays="7" /></Value></Leq></And></Or><And><IsNull><FieldRef Name="AssessmentSent" /></IsNull><Leq><FieldRef Name="AssessmentDue" /><Value Type="DateTime"><Today OffsetDays="7" /></Value></Leq></And></Or><And><IsNull><FieldRef Name="NextStepsSent" /></IsNull><Leq><FieldRef Name="NextStepsDue" /><Value Type="DateTime"><Today OffsetDays="7" /></Value></Leq></And></Or><Leq><FieldRef Name="NextUpdateDue" /><Value Type="DateTime"><Today OffsetDays="7" /></Value></Leq></Or></And></Where>

subactions.name: Letters for approval
subactions.query: <OrderBy><FieldRef Name="Modified" Ascending="FALSE" /></OrderBy><Where><Or><Eq><FieldRef Name="LetterStatus" /><Value Type="Choice">Ready for approval</Value></Eq><Eq><FieldRef Name="LetterStatus" /><Value Type="Choice">Awaiting approval</Value></Eq></Or></Where>
